svg.aria-label: A node table of 2 nodes and a semantic profile, mltl.closed-trace/v1, go into Formula::new, which returns a borrowed Formula or the first FormulaError. A signal catalog of 3 signals and 1 binding goes into SignalCatalog::new, which returns a SignalCatalog or the first SignalCatalogError. bind_formula joins the two into a BoundFormula when every proposition has a binding to a Boolean signal. The crate defines 4 semantic profiles.
